final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS overall_avg FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.brokrepstat, s1.avg_conf, s1.avg_conf - s2.overall_avg AS difference FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_conf > s2.overall_avg), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS above_avg FROM s3) SELECT s3.brokrepstat, s3.avg_conf, s3.difference, s3.avg_conf * 1.0 / NULLIF(s4.above_avg, 0) FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.above_avg IS NOT NULL
